label: Good capture
note: Whole board in view, sharp, facing the wall. This is what a good photo looks like.

label: A bit far away
note: Phone held far from the wall. Thick cracks still measure well. Watch which thin cracks get flagged.

label: Much too far away
note: The same photo shrunk to a quarter of its size, to mimic standing back. Nothing can be certified, so the agent asks you to move closer.

label: Closer shot
note: The recovery shot: the same photo at 8 px/mm, the distance the agent asked for.

label: Tilted view
note: Phone held at a steep angle. The board is rectified, but fewer cracks pass the gate. Watch the certified count.

label: Blurry and skewed
note: Soft focus and a steep angle. The agent asks you to hold steady and retake.

label: Board out of frame
note: Most of the board is outside the picture. No scale, so no number: the agent asks you to reposition.
